gaps.failure_mode: Obligations are imposed with no precedence rule between them
gaps.gap_title: Obligations are imposed with no precedence rule between them
gaps.operational_meaning: The document imposes duties but never says which provision prevails if two conflict, which cannot be waived, or what the document is subordinate to. A routine revision can therefore change what it actually requires without anyone treating that as a change of standard, and a reader facing two provisions that point different ways has no rule for deciding which governs.
